sections.title: Drug Discovery and Biotech ML
sections.description: For Biogen (Cambridge HQ), Moderna (Cambridge HQ), Vertex Pharmaceuticals (Boston HQ), and the Cambridge/Boston biotech cluster.

blocks.heading: Drug target identification ML
paragraphs: ML for identifying disease-relevant biological targets from genomic, proteomic, and phenotypic data for Boston's drug discovery programs — the computational biology applications that have made Boston one of the world's most productive drug discovery geographies.

blocks.heading: ADMET prediction
paragraphs: ML predicting absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity properties for chemical compounds in Biogen's and Vertex's drug discovery pipelines — enabling computational screening of large compound libraries before costly wet lab synthesis and testing.

blocks.heading: Clinical biomarker discovery
paragraphs: ML for identifying patient stratification biomarkers from genomic and proteomic datasets — predicting which patients will respond to specific therapies for the precision medicine programs at Boston's large biotech companies.

sections.title: Investment Risk and Quantitative Finance ML
sections.description: For Fidelity Investments (Boston HQ), State Street (Boston HQ), and Wellington Management (Boston HQ).

blocks.heading: Portfolio risk factor models
paragraphs: ML for quantitative risk factor identification and portfolio construction for Boston's large systematic and quantitative investment programs.

blocks.heading: Alternative data for fundamental research
paragraphs: ML for integrating alternative data (satellite, credit card, social sentiment) into fundamental investment research for the analysts at Boston's large fundamental investment organizations.

blocks.heading: Credit and fixed income analytics
paragraphs: ML for the fixed income and credit research programs at Fidelity's and State Street's large bond investment management operations — credit default prediction, spread forecasting, and portfolio construction ML for the trillion-dollar bond portfolios managed from Boston.

sections.title: Clinical Prediction and Health Services ML
sections.description: For Mass General Brigham, Dana-Farber, Boston Children's, and the Boston academic medical center network.

blocks.heading: Clinical deterioration and early warning
paragraphs: ML for the clinical early warning systems at Mass General Brigham's large hospital network — sepsis prediction, acute respiratory failure, and ICU transfer need identification from real-time clinical data for MGB's massive inpatient population.

blocks.heading: Oncology outcome prediction
paragraphs: ML for Dana-Farber's cancer treatment outcome research — predicting treatment response, toxicity risk, and overall survival for cancer patients based on tumor genomics, treatment history, and patient characteristics.

blocks.heading: Pediatric growth and development ML
paragraphs: ML for Boston Children's Hospital's pediatric clinical research — growth curve modeling, developmental milestone prediction, and pediatric disease outcome modeling for the specialized pediatric population.

sections.title: Robotics Perception and Control ML
sections.description: For Boston Dynamics (Waltham) and the 128 Technology Corridor robotics community.

blocks.heading: 3D environment understanding
paragraphs: ML for robot environmental perception — depth estimation, object recognition, and 3D scene understanding from camera and LiDAR sensor data for Boston Dynamics' and the broader robotics community's autonomous systems.

blocks.heading: Robot motion planning ML
paragraphs: ML for robot motion policy learning — enabling robots to learn complex manipulation and locomotion behaviors from demonstration and reinforcement learning for the advanced robotic systems that Boston's robotics community develops.

sections.title: Boston ML technical context
sections.description: Key technical considerations for Boston ML deployments.

blocks.heading: Self-hosted for biotech ML
paragraphs: Boston's drug discovery ML involves proprietary compound libraries and clinical data that cannot leave corporate networks — ClickMasters deploys training and inference infrastructure within corporate clouds for all Boston biotech ML applications.

blocks.heading: Research-grade reproducibility standards
paragraphs: Boston's scientific community requires ML development that meets research reproducibility standards — version-controlled training code, experiment tracking (MLflow or Weights & Biases), and held-out test set evaluation that independent scientists could reproduce.
